text:
ana_fin: Heads-up — I spotted ~120 GCP Marketplace invoices this morning where the exported CSV has an empty `usage.customer_tag` column. That tag is our reseller mapping key so the ingestion pipeline marks them as "unattributed" and stalls reconciliation.

sam.billing: Ugh. Any examples? invoice IDs or export lines?

ana_fin: Yep, pulled a snippet from the nightly export: ```invoice_id,sku,usage.customer_tag,units,amount
inv-2026-03-12-442,compute-std,,120,432.00
inv-2026-03-12-443,storage-prem,,2048,102.40
``` All other rows had tags normally. This is not a whole-bucket drop, looks sporadic across partners.

michael_ops: Did the GCP export schema change? We got a version bump last week on the exporter agent.

dina: I saw a failed ingest alert on the pipeline around `2026-03-12T06:42Z` — logs show "missing mapping key: customer_tag" for many rows, then the consumer retried and moved them to dead-letter. I can pull the DLQ samples.

ana_fin: DLQ samples would be great, thanks. We need to figure out if the tag was blank at source or stripped by our transform.

sam.billing: @invoicebot can you surface the exact CSV file from the storage dump that contains `inv-2026-03-12-442`?

invoicebot: Attached: gs://billing-exports/gcp/2026-03-12/marketplace-export-2026-03-12.csv (sha256: 9c0a7f...) — accessible to finance, billing, and ops.

michael_ops: Quick check: transform v2.1.4 (deployed 2026-03-11) includes a new normalization step that trims whitespace and drops `null`-like strings. Could be aggressive; maybe it treats "N/A" as empty. I'll diff the transform against prior version.

julian_rev: FYI some resellers reported anomalies in their portal timestamps this morning, might be related upstream. Also, did we hit any quota or partial export retries around that window? If GCP retried with partial objects we might have truncated metadata.

dina: DLQ samples look like real empties — not "N/A" strings. I'll paste one raw line: ```inv-2026-03-12-442,compute-std,,120,432.00,,,US-central``` — you can see double commas for the tag column.

sam.billing: If it's blank at source, marketplace partner mapping will fail. We need a two-step mitigation: 1) patch ingestion to accept empty tag and temporarily route to a "manual-match" queue with invoice metadata; 2) engage GCP partner support to confirm export completeness.

ana_fin: Agreed. I'll open a priority support ticket with GCP Marketplace and loop partners. @michael_ops can you start a hotfix branch to avoid DLQing on empty tags? We can tag them with `unmapped:today-03-12` to allow reconciliation.

michael_ops: On it — creating branch `billing/accept-empty-customer-tag` and will push a patch to map empty -> `unmapped:<date>` and emit telemetry. ETA ~1.5h.

julian_rev: I'll message channel partners to alert them and ask if they saw anything on their side.

sam.billing: Also add a Guardrail in Redwood Console alert: if >50 unattributed rows in a daily export, page oncall and finance.

dina: Added a temporary dashboard and alert. Will monitor DLQ count and message back here.

ana_fin: Thanks team. Once hotfix is up, I'll reprocess the affected files from the storage bucket. Please drop PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:

michael_ops: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/432 — includes tests and rollout steps.

sam.billing: Reprocessing started 2026-03-12T10:32Z. I'll post reconciliation status in a follow-up thread once we see matched invoices.

invoicebot: Automation note: reprocess job `reconcile-2026-03-12` queued by sam.billing — job id rc-20260312-77.

ana_fin: Follow-up: after remediation, ~108 of the 120 invoices were matched; 12 still need manual partner confirmation. Closing this loop tomorrow after partner responses. Thanks everyone.
